# PublicSource

> > PublicSource is Pittsburgh's nonprofit investigative journalism organization covering systemic inequity, youth voices, education funding, and government transparency.

PublicSource produces in-depth investigative reporting and community-driven journalism projects that amplify marginalized voices and expose structural inequalities in Pittsburgh and Pennsylvania. Their work includes data-driven tools like Board Explorer and narrative projects centering Black girls, low-wage workers, and education funding disparities.

## Key Topics

- Pittsburgh
- Investigative journalism
- Systemic inequity
- Black girls
- Education funding inequality
- Government transparency
- Board Explorer
- Community journalism
- Low-wage workers
- Youth voices
- Pennsylvania public education
- Unelected officials
- Identity and intersectionality
- Public records
- Economic inequality

## Investigative Projects

- [Failing the Future - Pennsylvania School Funding](https://schoolfundingpa.publicsource.org/): Investigative series on Pennsylvania public education funding inequality
- [Board Explorer](https://boards.publicsource.org/about/): About Board Explorer tool tracking Pittsburgh's unelected power structure

## Community Voices

- [I am a black girl and...](https://blackgirlspgh.publicsource.org/): Stories of Pittsburgh's Black girls exploring identity and experiences
- [Low-Wage Living](https://lowwageworkspgh.publicsource.org/): Pittsburgh low-wage workers' stories on housing and economic inequality
